pages.text: You have found one of the rare disks. There are five, never sold in shops and never crafted: they turn up in old chests, and in the chest of a ham shack (a little house with a J-pole on the roof, out in the country or in a village).$(br2)Install them like any other disk; the disk is not used up, so pass it round.

pages.title: Snake
pages.text: $(thing)SNAKE$(): eat, grow, and do not bite your own tail. Arrows or WASD steer, P pauses. The ten best scores on each computer are kept on its disk ($(thing)SNAKE.DAT$()).

pages.title: Pileup
pages.text: $(thing)PILEUP$(): callers fall into the band. Fill a row edge to edge to work them: a QSO, and the row leaves the band. Every 8 QSOs you move up a band, from 160m to 70cm, and it gets faster. Left/Right move, Up turns, Down drops, Space slams.

pages.title: Music Player
pages.text: $(thing)MUSIC$(): forty-three tunes, Joplin and Bach to chiptune, jazz, rock and RPG themes, from the computer's small, tinny speakers, or from speakers connected to it (touching it, or wall speakers and loudspeakers on its data wire). Only you hear it, at your master and jukebox volume. It plays on in other programs and after $(thing)Close$() (C); it stops out of earshot or when the computer loses power. Enter plays, Space pauses, S stops, Left and Right go back and on, R repeats, H shuffles, - and + set the volume.

pages.title: Bible
pages.text: $(thing)BIBLE$(): the four gospels of the World English Bible (public domain). Left and Right turn the chapter; F3 goes to a verse (John 3:16), F4 picks a book and chapter, F5 finds verses with every word you type.

pages.title: Screensaver
pages.text: $(thing)SAVER$(): after a few idle minutes the screen shows a starfield, your callsign in big letters, or a band waterfall, and the computer draws a quarter of its power until a key, click or mouse move wakes it. SETUP's $(thing)Screensaver$() page sets the wait (or never) and which one; SAVER.EXE blanks the screen at once.
